bug_semantics: containerd CRI Attach (kubectl attach / CRI pods/attach) registers the client's stdout/stderr writers on ContainerIO writer groups and then blocks a monitor goroutine (Attach.func1 / attachStream) on a WriteCloseInformer close channel with a bare `<-close`. That channel is signaled only when the writer-group later Closes/Removes the informer (container stdout/stderr EOF, stdin-copy teardown, or a write error). If the attached container produces no further stdout/stderr, client disconnect never drives a Write, so Close is never observed. Attach also ignored the streaming HTTP/gRPC request context, so ctx cancellation could not unblock the wait, remove the writer-group entry, or return from wg.Wait(). Repeated Attach calls therefore leak those goroutines and their stack/heap, exhausting host memory (CWE-401).
flaw_origin: The leak is the original CRI attach design, not a later regression. On 2017-08-23 Lantao Liu landed cri-containerd PR #128 commit 45ee2e554a226a86bef50889b579d94b4180e5fc ('Add container attach support.'), which first wrote pkg/server/io/io.go ContainerIO.Attach with attachStream waiting only on `<-close` and then wg.Wait(). Parent 77b703f1e701a79ade3fc25fc60c40add44fe476 still had Attach as a 'not implemented' stub and had no attachStream/WriteCloseInformer. Later moves/refactors (e41b6d3c container_io.go split, 2020 history-preserving merge e7a350176a of containerd/cri, pkg/cri and internal/cri relocations) preserved the same `<-close` wait until the 2025 ctx.Done() fix.

reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2025-64329/GHSA-m6hq-p25p-ffr2 is a published (not withdrawn) medium CWE-401 in containerd CRI Attach. The sink is the attachStream monitor that waits only for the WriteCloseInformer close channel and for Attach to wg.Wait() without observing client cancellation. When kubectl attach / CRI Attach is repeated against a still-running container that emits no further stdout/stderr, those goroutines never finish and containerd RSS grows. The 2025 fix is the missing ctx.Done() arm plus writer-group Remove on cancel, matching the leak. BIC search used -S attachStream and parent-tree verification, not AI-commit inversion: 45ee2e554a226a86bef50889b579d94b4180e5fc is the smallest public commit that first wrote the `<-close` attachStream + wg.Wait() mechanism in pkg/server/io/io.go; its parent still stubs Attach. cri PR 128 is a two-commit rebase merge whose head is this SHA, so it is not a squash aggregate and needs no decomposition. Subsequent container_io.go refactors and the 2020 cri→containerd history merge carried the same wait; they are not BICs. Fixes 083b53cd6 (main/2.2) and the 1.7/2.0/2.1 backports land exactly on the advisory patched versions. AI judgment is BIC-object-only: 2017 human maintainer Lantao Liu with only Signed-off-by, no commit-object AI marker. Therefore NOT_AI.
